summary: V3 RBAC + multi-tenant password/subscription testing completed. 34/34 backend pytest pass (14 new V3 tests + 20 updated V2 tests). All V3 backend features verified: Director role login, Admin role (migrated from MD), 5 new seeded users (Bablu/Sangram/Sagar/Abhirami/Tushar), owner_id persistence on passwords & subscriptions, owner_name expansion for Admin view, Bablu scoped to own data, 403 on other user's reveal, Admin PUT module_permissions with new {access, scope} dict format persists and is reflected in /auth/me, view/overall scope lets Bablu see admin subs but blocks POST with 403, access=none blocks GET with 403. ONE CRITICAL REGRESSION FOUND: GET /api/users returns 0 for Admin/Director because legacy check 'role == MD' was not updated post-migration - blocks the entire User Management UI from rendering the list.

critical.issue: Returns 0 users for Admin and Director (both see empty list). server.py line 421 still uses legacy check: `query = {} if current_user['role'] == 'MD' else {'manager_id': current_user['_id']}`. After V3 role migration (MD -> Admin, Director added), neither Admin nor Director matches 'MD' so they fall into the else branch filtering by manager_id, which returns nothing. Impact: User Management page is empty in UI, Admin cannot create/edit/view users, blocking all admin user-management flows.
critical.fix_hint: Change line 421 to: `query = {} if current_user['role'] in ('MD','Admin','Director') else {'manager_id': current_user['_id']}`

minor.issue: Legacy seeded password entry 'Resource Tracker' has no owner_id, shows owner_name='—' fallback in Admin list. Functional but cosmetic noise from pre-V3 data.

ui_bugs.issue: User list is empty because GET /api/users returns []. Cascading effect of the backend bug above - no users visible, no Edit buttons available, cannot reach PermissionEditor. Need backend fix first to retest the PermissionEditor (Access x Scope dropdowns), role dropdown options in Create New User modal, and role badges (Director/Admin).

rca_of_issue: RCA: V3 patch added Director/Admin roles (with auto-migration MD->Admin) and centralised RoleChecker.require_md = RoleChecker('Director','Admin','MD'). However, server.py get_users (line 421) has an inline role-string check `if current_user['role'] == 'MD'` that was NOT updated. After migration, the seeded admin user has role='Admin' (not 'MD'), so this check fails, falling to `{'manager_id': current_user['_id']}` which matches zero docs. Reproduction: curl /api/users with Admin token returns []. Expected: returns all users. Mitigation: replace with `current_user['role'] in ('MD','Admin','Director')` or extract helper `is_admin_or_director(user)` and use consistently across server.py (also seen at lines 622 and 649 for dashboard/reports scoping, which should be audited for the same stale check pattern).
